Many service errors, dishes poorly prepared
Mar 2026 • Friends
The overall experience at this restaurant was very disappointing. The staff, including the cooks, made numerous errors, and were ill informed about Japanese food and the dishes offered by the restaurant. One dish ordered was a seared tuna known as maguro takaki. It’s a common dish in which the exterior ring is seared leaving the interior raw, and prepared without seasoning. Instead, what was delivered was tuna slices seared over the entire face of the slice and soaked in sauce with onions. When I pointed out the difference between the menu photo and the delivered dish, the staff surprisingly could not understand the difference. One dish I did like was an abalone dish but when I ordered a second they delivered sea snails and were hesitant to admit that they made any error. I asked that they please prepare the abalone. But 15 minutes later another staff member came by and asked if I still wanted the abalone. And there were basic problems. The tebasaki grilled chicken wing dish was not crispy at all and wasn’t even tebasaki but one small wing and one small
drumstick, in sauce. The edamame soy beans were also soaked in sauce, not salted as is traditionally done. Overall one of the worst Japanese restaurants I have experienced.

Added extra service charge
Oct 2022 • Solo
When I arrived to eat here I was actually really looking forward to my meal- really nice surroundings, authentic music, incredibly clean and the food looked good. I had fried okra and fish which was tasty if a little heavy handed on the batter. I also had a lovely umeshi cocktail that was fragrant and refreshing and some rolled steak with cheese that was succulent but rich. However service-wise I was totally ignored- waited in a restaurant that was only a fifth full for my plates to be taken or someone to come over for 15 minutes. I’m an automatic tipper when the service is good, but had decided that this wouldn’t warrent a tip. Being a little tired I didn’t look at the bill and paid and left however on closer inspection they have charged three seperate service amounts- 5%, 8% and 10%. After checking at my hostel and online I know that this absolutely isn’t the correct protocol or amount and can only assume (maybe wrongly) that it’s because I’m a Westerner. Very disappointing.

Sullied Reputation
Feb 2020 • Couples
Have eaten there once before but last night’s service was terrible. The two of were sitting at the counter and had ordered two dishes. Unless sitting at the large party tables and ordering copious amounts of food and drink, we were practically ignored. When we ordered two more simple dishes, it took almost 20 minutes to get a simple order of steamed veggies. 

This is a restaurant off Dong Khoi and you expect the prices to be higher because of location. But I expect service to be more attentive. They had plenty of staff and 4 chefs, so no excuse.

No more. “The First” off Nguyen Hue is the go to spot nearby or go over to the Japanese section of D1 with greater choice of restaurants and less expensive prices. 

Visitors beware of dining in “name eateries” like this or those on ground level around Dong Khoi - tourist traps.
